Coram : S.S. NIJJAR*, F.M. IBRAHIM KALIFULLA
A B Investigation - Entrustment of - To independent investigating agency - Murder of political leader - C Investigation by State Police, CID and CBI - Dissatisfied with the investigation, writ petition by wife of the deceased seeking investigation by higher authorities of CBI - Alleging - Held: In order to ensure that the criminal prosecution is carried on without any deficiency, Court D can constitute Special Investigation Team - The courts can also monitor such investigation - The proceedings/ investigation in the present case was not carried out in a satisfactory manner -
Decision Date : 08-10-2013 | Case No : WRIT PETITION (CRIMINAL) No. 159/2012 | Disposal Nature : Directions issued | Direction Issue : Passing the order and keeping the petition pending for passing necessary orders if and when required | Bench : 2 Judges
